title: CallNotifyCriteriaListGet
description: User call notify criteria response object containing configurations of Criteria.

id.description: Unique identifier for the call notify criteria.

scheduleName.description: Name of the schedule associated with the criteria.

source.description:
Type of the source.
 * `ALL_NUMBERS` - User wants to be notified for calls from Any Phone Number.
 * `SPECIFIC_NUMBERS` - User wants to be notified for calls from Select Phone Numbers.

notificationEnabled.description: Determines whether call notify is applied for calls matching this criteria. If `true`, call notification is applied. If `false`, this criteria acts as a 'Don't Notify Me' rule, preventing call notification. Criteria with `notificationEnabled` set to `false` (Don't Notify Me) take precedence over criteria with `notificationEnabled` set to `true` (Notify Me).
